title: Login Roles and Group Roles
summary: Use NOLOGIN group roles such as app_readwrite and app_readonly, then grant per-service login roles into them.
learning_objectives: Separate login roles from privilege bundles in a service design.
Grant membership into app_readwrite and app_readonly without over-granting direct object privileges.
Explain why group roles should normally be NOLOGIN.
reflection_prompts: Which permission would you remove first if this role were leaked?
What SQL evidence would you attach to an access review?
